steps.label: login-gate check
steps.note: LOGIN-GATED login-required. Compose → to (input[name='to'], aria-label 'To' recipient), subject (input[name='subjectbox']), body (div[aria-label='Message Body'][contenteditable='true']), send (the site's own Send button div[role='button'][gh='send'] / 'Send'). DOM-UNVERIFIED. If the attached session returns the real composer and a sent confirmation reads back, capture then verify; NEVER fabricate a sent email without a verified live read-back.
